title: Protection & Controls Engineering Manager
description:
Overview:

**We are designing the grid of the future!**

The Protection & Controls Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership for protection and control engineering across EPC and private-client projects, including substations, generation facilities, BESS, data centers, industrial facilities and other large-load interconnections.

The role will lead the development and review of P&C designs from conceptual engineering through detailed design, construction and commissioning. * Develop and review protection philosophies and schemes for transformers, buses, feeders, transmission lines, capacitor/reactor banks, generators and other electrical equipment.
* Develop and review protective relay settings and coordination, including overcurrent, differential, distance, breaker-failure and communications-assisted protection.
* Perform and review short-circuit, equipment-duty and protection coordination studies required to support the design.
